title: Repository automation Ready transition separation mitigation

phases.objective: Prevent repository automation from changing a Draft pull request to Ready and invoking finalization in the same automatic plan while the final review-state boundary remains under repair.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: pr_delivery and full_workstream plans may retain separately authorized finalization but never contain an automatic mark_ready step.
steps: Verify both plans retain pr_finalize as a separately authorized mutation.
Keep direct finalization blocked by the unresolved review-state P0 and independent approval gates.
assertions: No automatic plan can transition Draft to Ready and finalize in one apply cycle.
The mitigation does not claim to repair final review-state TOCTOU.
No repository protected ref, Production, provider, deployment, credential, SQL, migration, database, or external-send authority is introduced.

phases.objective: Deliver the final review-state reread and server-side required-review enforcement proof tracked in issue 5872.
Prove automatic-plan safety across retries, resume operations, and stale persisted plans.
This repository-only mitigation performs no provider or runtime canary.
This mitigation grants no deployment, Production, provider, database, migration, credential, or external-send authority.
